# Nova Widget Mini

## Overview
The [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) Mini is a cost-effective variant of the Nova Widget product line specifically designed for hobbyists. It serves as a compact and accessible [hardware](./hardware.md) option featuring a capacitive soil probe and wireless capabilities.

## Key Details
- **Hardware Components:** Powered by a CR2032 coin cell battery, equipped with a capacitive soil probe, and built around the nRF52840 microcontroller.
- **[Firmware](./firmware.md) Configuration:** Ships with MeshSync enabled by default, operating on a 15-minute reporting interval. Over-the-air (OTA) updates are currently deferred.
- **Target Audience:** Positioned as an affordable alternative for hobbyist and maker applications.
